section.title: DICOM Default Transfer Syntax
section.para: The DICOM Implicit VR Little Endian Transfer Syntax (identified by Transfer Syntax UID = "1.2.840.10008.1.2") shall be supported by every conformant DICOM Implementation.

section.label: A.1
section.title: DICOM Implicit VR Little Endian Transfer Syntax
section.para: This Transfer Syntax applies to the encoding of the entire DICOM Data Set.

listitem.para: The Data Elements contained in the Data Set structure shall be encoded with Implicit VR (without a VR Field).
The encoding of the overall Data Set structure (Data Element Tags, Value Length, and Value) shall be in Little Endian.

section.para: This DICOM Implicit VR Little Endian Transfer Syntax shall be identified by a UID of Value "1.2.840.10008.1.2".

section.label: A.2
section.title: DICOM Little Endian Transfer Syntax (Explicit VR)

listitem.para: The Data Elements contained in the Data Set structure shall be encoded with Explicit VR (with a VR Field).
The encoding of the overall Data Set structure (Data Element Tags, Value Length, and Value) shall be in Little Endian.

section.para: This DICOM Explicit VR Little Endian Transfer Syntax shall be identified by a UID of Value "1.2.840.10008.1.2.1".

section.label: A.3
section.title: DICOM Big Endian Transfer Syntax (Explicit VR)
section.para: This Transfer Syntax was retired in 2006.

section.label: A.4
section.title: Transfer Syntaxes for Encapsulation of Encoded Pixel Data

listitem.para: The Data Elements contained in the Data Set structure shall be encoded with Explicit VR (with a VR Field).
The encoding of the overall Data Set structure (Data Element Tags, Value Length, etc.) shall be in Little Endian.
Pixel Data (7FE0,0010) may be Encapsulated Format or Native Format. It shall be Encapsulated Format if present in the top-level Data Set.

section.label: A.5
section.title: DICOM Deflated Explicit VR Little Endian Transfer Syntax
section.para: The entire Data Set is first encoded according to the rules specified in .
The entire byte stream is then compressed using the Deflate algorithm.
This DICOM Deflated Explicit VR Little Endian Transfer Syntax shall be identified by a UID of Value "1.2.840.10008.1.2.1.99".
